player_prompt.intro:
O o Mmopi {player_id} mo kgweding ya GameOfPureStrategy.
- O na le karata e 13 A-K; tshwana e ka tsenwa ka nngwe.
- Mo kgweding le le lengwe, kareteng ya prize e a bonwa. Tsena kareteng e le nngwe kwa go ngwala sengwe se se nang token e jaaka '[Q]', '[10]', '[2]' ...
- Kareteng e kwa godimo e tsena prize (le go tsaya carry-over). Dikgetho di tsamaya le prize go ya go tsenyana mo pot kwa kgweding le le lengwe.
- Nngwe e kwa godimo ka madi a a tsenyang a kgweding 13 a tsena.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Action must contain exactly ONE bracketed card token.
invalid_move.card_not_held: Ga o tlhole o na le karata eo.

message.tie: {observation}Tie -> pot now {carry_pot}. Go ne go le thata gore ke dire jalo ka gonne e ne ya re fa ba sena go dira sengwe, ga se kitla se kgona go nna monate gape.

outcome.draw: Bobedi jwa bone ba ne ba fentsha {s0}
